title: Nature Scavenger Hunt
engine: custom DOM game with shared QLOBE screens, recorded voice, HUD, tap, timers, persistence, seeded RNG, and debug modules
shareTitle: Nature Scavenger Hunt — Three Tiny Outdoor Trails
description: Turn the tablet into a clay field guide, then look away from the screen to find three safe outdoor treasures by color, texture, sound, shape, or size. Every thoughtful find counts.
learningGoals: Name and compare observable colors, shapes, sizes, textures, and sounds
Transfer a visual and spoken descriptor from the screen to a real object
Explain why more than one outdoor find can fit the same category
Practice slow looking, gentle touch, and careful listening outdoors
interactionModel: Choose Nature Mix, Texture Trail, or Color Quest; review three clues on a clay clipboard; explore the real world; and tap the oversized Found it plaque after each self-reported discovery.
feedbackModel: Each find lifts inside a golden clay halo with a pop, raster treasure burst, and warm teacher praise; there is no timer, wrong answer, score, camera, microphone, or location check.

modes.title: Nature Mix
modes.skill: categorizing a find by one observable quality

modes.title: Texture Trail
modes.skill: comparing tactile qualities safely and gently

modes.title: Color Quest
modes.skill: noticing colors in natural objects and tiny details

assets.art: Claymation raster family generated with GPT Image 2, cut with tools/cut-asset-sheet.py, separated or matted at authoring time, and alpha-QA'd; Krea 2 supplies the separate Toy-grammar hub tile.
assets.voice: Qwen3 TTS voice-clone teacher narration, normalized to AAC and admitted only after per-line Whisper transcript QA; Web Speech is the offline-safe fallback.
